result.title: Calibrating Document-Local Boundaries for Contextual Chunk Retrieval
result.summary: Late Chunking encodes an entire document before pooling at chunk boundaries, preserving document context in local retrieval units. Chunk-level post-training improves context-dependent retrieval, but shared context can make semantically similar same-document negatives difficult to distinguish. We study the local decision boundary between a gold chunk and its hardest sibling. Starting from InSeNT, we analyze InSeNT's within-document gradients and show that the entropy of the conditional negative allocation decreases monotonically with the scaling factor at fixed logits. We propose a two-part framework for calibrating document-local chunk boundaries. The first component adapts the discriminative scale from within-document margins, while the second exposes chunk partitions to attention during document encoding. Experiments on ConTEB and NanoBEIR show that the resulting model improves contextual chunk retrieval across the evaluated encoder settings while retaining competitive passage-level retrieval quality; ablations further characterize the distinct roles of adaptive scaling and chunk-aware routing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 late chunking 文档块检索中金标块与其最难同文档负例之间的局部决策边界，分析文档内梯度并指出条件负例分配的熵随缩放因子单调下降，进而提出由文档内 margin 自适应调整判别尺度、并在文档编码时让块划分参与注意力路由的两部分框架，在 ConTEB 与 NanoBEIR 上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按文档内相似度 margin 校准判别尺度」与「让划分单元参与注意力路由」可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态相似度的尺度与边界校准、以及视觉证据区域的选择性路由，但研究对象是文本检索，与视觉多模态推理无直接联系，迁移价值需读原文判断。
